about.title: About Us
about.story_text: Sol Running Club was born in Göteborg from the passion of a small group of runners who wanted to share more than kilometers: they wanted to share energy, motivation and the beauty of running through the streets and parks of this incredible city. We started as four friends and today we are a vibrant community of runners of all levels.
about.story_text2: Our name, Sol, reflects the positive energy we bring to every training session. Even though Göteborg doesn't always have sun, we always bring it with us.
about.value1_text: We are a club for everyone: beginners, intermediate and advanced. Nobody gets left behind.
about.value2_text: More than a running club, we are a family that supports each other.
about.value3_text: We run because we love running. The joy of every kilometer drives us.
about.monday_desc: Easy start-of-week training. Ideal for beginners and to activate the body.
about.thursday_desc: Interval and technique training. For all levels with adapted groups.
about.sunday_desc: Long weekend run. We explore routes through the parks and the Göta river.
